title: 8 Small Lies a Godly Man Refuses to Let Become Normal
caption:
"I'm on my way." "I didn't see it." "I've got it handled." None of them feel like lying anymore. That's exactly the problem.

A godly man doesn't get to grade his own honesty on a curve just because the lie is small and everybody does it. Put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor, the small ones included.

The lies that cost the least are the ones that spread the fastest.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #honesty #integrity
